2607.14756.title: AI vs Human Expert Reasoning: Assessing Agreements in Building Typology Predictions based on Street View Imagery
2607.14756.paper_summary: This research investigates the potential of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to infer building typologies: Construction, Current Use, and Storeys from Google Street View (GSV) images. Predictions generated by VLMs are compared with inference by human experts (civil engineers and architects) as a source of manually labelled ground-truth data. We evaluate several state-of-the-art VLMs, including GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Gemini 2.0 Flash. By applying different scaling strategies and prompting techniques, we found that Chain-of-Thought prompts provide an overall more stable model performance. We also investigate the reasoning behind VLMs' building-typology predictions by examining the probabilities of keywords appearing in AI explanations. This enabled us to analyse patterns in these reasonings and identify key themes driving both agreements and disagreements between VLM and expert labels. We find that AI tends to focus on visual indicators, whereas human experts place greater emphasis on broader contextual cues and domain knowledge, in addition to visual cues. Overall, VLM can approximate experts' capability in building-typology classification at scale, with an average accuracy of approximately 70%. The study demonstrates the VLM's potential for AI automation in tasks that require pattern recognition and object identification in an urban context. AI have the potential to serve as complementary and collaborative tools for urban analysis, leveraging their strengths in understanding visual patterns. This study contributes to the exploration of the efficiency and scalability of AI visual prediction and provides insights into the reasoning processes that could support automation processes in urban analysis and prediction.
2607.14756.paper_summary_zh: 這項研究探討了視覺-語言模型（VLM）推斷建築類型的潛力：建設、當前使用和樓層，基於 Google 街景（GSV）圖像。由 VLM 生成的預測與人類專家（土木工程師和建築師）的推斷進行比較，以作為手動標記的真實數據來源。我們評估了幾個最先進的 VLM，包括 GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet 和 Gemini 2.0 Flash。通過應用不同的擴展策略和提示技術，我們發現思維鏈提示提供了整體上更穩定的模型性能。我們還通過檢查關鍵詞在 AI 解釋中出現的概率，來研究 VLM 建築類型預測背後的推理。這使我們能夠分析這些推理中的模式，並確定推動 VLM 和專家標籤之間一致性和不一致性的關鍵主題。我們發現 AI 傾向於關注視覺指標，而人類專家則更重視更廣泛的上下文線索和領域知識，除了視覺線索之外。總體而言，VLM 可以在規模上接近專家在建築類型分類中的能力，平均準確率約為 70%。這項研究展示了 VLM 在需要模式識別和物體識別的城市背景任務中的 AI 自動化潛力。AI 有潛力成為城市分析的補充和協作工具，利用其在理解視覺模式方面的優勢。這項研究有助於探索 AI 視覺預測的效率和可擴展性，並提供了支持城市分析和預測自動化過程的推理過程的見解。
